cues.text: This is a simulation. An approved S3 policy request leaves the backend.
Did the change fail? Or just the reply?
Before the call, the durable ledger already records CALLING.
AWSOps keeps that uncertainty. It does not blindly send another write.
It reconciles the same run, using read-only provider checks.
But a matching policy is not fresh Config compliance.
Execution stays UNKNOWN. Compliance stays UNKNOWN.
The missing evidence stays visible. This demonstrates control logic, not live acceptance.
